entities.name: Trebizond Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Trebizond Empire, a political institution in Georgia during Golden Age of Georgia (1184–1213). Grew from David the Builder liberates Tbilisi from the Arab emirate and Battle of Didgori — decisive Georgian victory over the Seljuks. Led to the emergence of Queen Tamar and Shota Rustaveli composes 'The Knight in the Panther's Skin'.
